final_message: Removed exec records (plan/result/events) from the VitePress sidebar and split the sidebar by path (ja/en). /ja/specdojo/ shows only the specdojo section; /ja/projects/<id>/ shows only that project. Enabled metaChunk (not in the ticket) so the site data, including the sidebar, is no longer inlined into every page. Added an exec-records.md list page generated by `specdojo dashboard build`, linked from the dashboard, so exec records stay reachable. npm run docs:build succeeds without NODE_OPTIONS. Scan of 2,175 built pages: 0 sidebars with exec records, 0 specdojo pages with a project sidebar, 0 prj-0001 pages missing the project sidebar. Dist 2.9GB -> 568MB; specdojo-overview-guide.html 1,405,099 -> 119,895 bytes. Build time is not comparable: 413s wall (user 205s) in the sandbox vs 193s recorded before in a different environment; needs re-measurement in the same environment. Ticket work table and results updated; frontmatter and status untouched.
